visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a camouflage military uniform with a helmet and a scar painted on his face shouts while holding a black rifle in a grassy field with a white wall in the background. A second man, dressed as a monk with a bald cap and brown robes, stands calmly with a shepherd's staff. (2) The scene cuts to the soldier arguing with a younger man in a green and white athletic jacket who is also holding a rifle. They gesture toward the monk, who remains serene with hands in prayer. (3) Close-ups show the soldier and the younger man debating, while the monk speaks with hands on his chest. Graphic overlays of red and blue human icons and a bullet appear to illustrate combat logic. (4) The monk raises his arms as a bright yellow glowing aura surrounds him, simulating a magical conversion skill. He suddenly stops and looks down at his robes as if something changed. (5) The video transitions to an advertisement for 'Age of Empires Mobile,' showing detailed character art of historical figures and gameplay footage on mobile devices.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy vocal roll call, featuring a man shouting numbers with high intensity. Short, rhythmic BGM stabs emphasize the cuts. (2) Dialogue begins between two male voices in an outdoor setting; the primary voice is aggressive and fast-paced, while the second is skeptical and conversational. Subtle nature-floor ambient noise is audible. (3) A calm, deeper male voice enters, speaking with a serene tone. A playful, comedic BGM track starts, contrasting the earlier shouting. (4) A digital chime SFX triggers as the monk makes a point. The dialogue continues with rapid back-and-forth speech and clear articulation. (5) A loud, shimmering 'conversion' hum SFX plays, accompanied by a riser that cuts abruptly. (6) The audio shifts to a cinematic commercial style with epic orchestral music and a deep, authoritative male narrator speaking in Taiwanese Hokkien.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a comedic promotional sketch for the mobile game 'Age of Empires Mobile.' It uses the 'monk's conversion ability' as a comedic hook to engage viewers before transitioning into a direct game advertisement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video ends with a full-screen graphic advertisement for the mobile game, including store links and game footage.
